remarks: Some homes simply check boxes. This one redefines what life in Fairfield County can look like.   Set on a coveted cul-de-sac in the heart of Wilton, this fully updated 5-bedroom retreat offers a rare blend of privacy, beauty, and convenience-just minutes to top-rated schools, Wilton Center, and the charming downtowns of Ridgefield and New Canaan.  It's the way this home makes you feel that sets it apart. Step outside and exhale. Open skies, mature trees, and birdsong create a setting that feels worlds away, with the Wilton Riding Club, its summer camp, pool, tennis, paddle courts and miles of nature trails nearby. The expansive, usable property invites both relaxation and possibility, with room for a future pool, barn, or accessory dwelling unit (ADU). Designed for effortless living and entertaining, the outdoor spaces shine-from the expansive back deck at sunset to lawn games on the open grounds, to long dinners with friends on the screened-in porch. Unwind year-round in the barrel sauna, your own private wellness escape.  A newly built fenced garden with raised beds awaits your vision-whether heirloom vegetables, fresh herbs, or cutting flowers.  Inside, thoughtfully updated and carefully curated interiors deliver turnkey ease with timeless appeal.  This is Wilton living at its most idyllic: natural, connected, and ready for what comes next.
